justification: Removes links to four products site-wide and adds noindex. Not Critical: no data or rule change; pages still work. Not Minor: 50 files of user-facing navigation and copy.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if any page, component or lib file contains a route string pointing at a withdrawn product.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Owner instruction 2026-10-28: remove flood, bushfire, solar (and climate risk) from all menus, sitemaps and links.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the edits the test listed 120 links in 43 files.

pre_impl.existing_data: No product visibility switch existed; only per-page noindex metadata.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: /reports routes leave middleware early, so the header is set on both exits.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One new list file; every other change removes existing links.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Not applicable: no external source is called.

functions.name: isHiddenPath
functions.what: Matches a withdrawn route or any of its sub-pages.
functions.input: a path or full URL string
functions.output: true when the path is withdrawn
functions.if_none: A malformed URL returns false, not an error.
functions.failure_mode: A missed prefix leaves a page indexed; the gate test lists every prefix

functions.name: sitemap
functions.input: sitemap chunk id from the index
functions.output: sitemap entries with withdrawn routes removed
functions.if_none: A chunk with only withdrawn routes returns an empty list.
functions.edge_cases: chunks 2-4 kept so the index never 404s

break_it.scenario: A new blog post links to /reports/flood
break_it.what_happens: The link gate test fails in CI

break_it.scenario: Google crawls /flood-risk/penrith from an old link
break_it.what_happens: The page is served with X-Robots-Tag noindex
Chunk 2 returns an empty but valid sitemap

gaps: Prose that mentions the products without a link (e.g. /for/homebuyers hero) not rewritten
Site brief still shows flood, bushfire and solar sections (owner to decide)

post_merge.action: After deploy: curl -I a withdrawn page for X-Robots-Tag; fetch sitemaps 0-7 and confirm no withdrawn URL
post_merge.manual_verify: Header, footer and home page show no flood, bushfire, solar or climate links

real_layer_exempt.frontend-nextjs/middleware.ts: Adds one response header; checked live after deploy.
